notes.title: Infected Shelter leaves Early Access!!! Version 1.0 available now!
notes.notes:
Infected Shelter leaves Early Access!!! Version 1.0 available now!

The big moment has come and Infected Shelter 1.0 is out now on Steam!

Thank you for the support over the time of the development!

We've added a lot of content and changes since Infected Shelter was available in Early Access, and a lot of the changes have come directly from player feedback.

After the release of the 1.0 version, we will continue to add new content and localize the game to more languages, so if you want to see more, be sure to let us know.

Now, without further words, let's play Infected Shelter!

[previewyoutube=b1FnxXVKw7k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Crossing the Floor
notes.notes:
Change! It is as inevitable as it is clich d. All things must change, from your town and workplace to your bank balance and attitude towards seagulls (they are brilliant). One thing that does not change, however, is the endless deluge of games from Steam, and my place writing Unknown Pleasures.

What, you thought because our conquest of Castle Shotgun has begun, we would leave behind the bloody indie death halls? Psh. Our regular round-up of the best obscure games on Steam is the source of my power.

Settling in for the long haul this week:

notes.title: Update --- Early-Access build (06-May-2019) - v.0.6.0506
notes.notes:
Thank you for the alpha/beta testers and pre-early access version streamers for the feedbacks and the videos. Based on these feedbacks we fixed all of the bugs you reported or we saw in videos, and we also balanced a lot of little things. 

So we finally reached this version which will be the early access release day version of the game tomorrow.

Some of the latest improvements:

- Auto-detected controller support and controller icon support for PS4, XBox, Nintendo Switch Pro, and also Switch JoyCon Left and Right controllers. If you still experience ?? icons with some controllers please report us in the Discussions. You also can manually change the controller icons if the auto-detect cannot recognize your controller properly.

- The beginning of the game is easier for the new players. We decreased the AI aggressivity level in the early stages and also decreased the HP and damage values of the first bosses. The difficulty of the early stages are increasing slowly in several steps after you defeat any of the first bosses and when you unlock significant amount of blueprints.

- The Options menus are ready, Gameplay, Graphics, Audio options are added in the latest days. If you have any more suggestions for Gameplay or other options, let us know in the Discussions.

- The Barbarian trait has changed a little. Your melee weapons can break now (but rarely) when you have the Barbarian trait. There was a very OP combination of the Barbarian trait and any of the freeze DOT weapons, so we had to adjust the trait.

- We also fixed and changed a lot of other little things in the weeks of beta testing based on your feedbacks.


There are still some suggestions / problems you've already reported but we still have to think about it, or we need more time to implement them into the game. 

We are a small team, only 2 person, so thank you for your patience if we are answering a few days later for any of your comments or emails. 

We would like to improve the game during the early access months based on your feedbacks, so please use the Discussion forums or any of our other channels to contact us and tell us your suggestions.

Thank you!

notes.title: Who wants to be a beta tester?
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33478547/ad5ae98b5164d679901473883cf5a7022a77d4ab.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

We'd like to let you know that we're now taking applications for Beta testers. With the Early Access right around the corner (probably in May of 2019) we're looking to get some experienced players.

We need people committed to helping us improve the game, players who can analyse specific reference points and give constructive feedback. 

We'll be prioritizing individuals with experience playing rogue-like / rogue-lite games. (Rogue Legacy, Enter the gungeon, Lost Castle, Rampage Knights, Dead Cells, Dungreed, Wizard of Legend, etc.). 

Please bear in mind, if you decide to apply and are selected, you'll be testing an early beta build. This means all sorts of bugs, instability, unfinished things and a general lack of balance in the gameplay.

Playing an early version of a game can also damage the overall player experience, so It may be wiser to restrain yourself for now, and wait for the early access release, if you're not ready for some crashes, bugs and general breakage. 

If you're still interested despite all of this, you can apply through this google form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScQnd5562-lTwsIJ3JrZWnqvYZkv17QZXV94TI-AqM0j7G5Sw/viewform

If you don't hear from us then you haven't been selected. If you do, you'll receive a Steam key via the email address provided to us. Please note we'll be taking a limited number of testers each week (probably only 20-30 at a time).

We can't wait to see your feedback.
